known.via: English Wikipedia "Desierto de Almería" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: An Andalusian vino de la tierra (IGP) covering fourteen municipalities in Almería province, including Tabernas and Sorbas. It sits one step below the DO level on the Spanish quality ladder and gained its status in 2003.
